title: EARAS/REXA Answer Annotation Schema
description: Schema describing the fields captured for every annotated student answer used to train the REXA ML modules. Matches the records found in data/raw/sample_answers.json and data/processed/{train,val,test}.json.

question_id.description: Foreign key into sample_questions.json id field, e.g. 'q01'.

student_answer.description: Full raw text of the student's descriptive answer.

reference_answer.description: Model/reference answer for the associated question, duplicated here for convenience.

concepts.description: Full list of concepts the question expects a strong answer to cover.

sentence_roles.description: Ordered list of the student's sentences with an assigned discourse role.

concepts_present.description: Subset of 'concepts' judged to be present/covered in the student answer.

support_pairs.description: Pairwise relation labels between consecutive (or related) sentences, indexed into sentence_roles.

i.description: Index of the source sentence in sentence_roles.

j.description: Index of the target sentence in sentence_roles.

depth_score.description: Continuous reasoning-depth score in [0, 1] capturing how well-formed the Claim->Evidence->Explanation->Conclusion chain is.

stars.description: Overall holistic quality rating on a 1-5 star scale (ground truth target for the star-prediction module).

stars_continuous.description: Optional unrounded star value, useful for regression-style training/evaluation.

quality_tier.description: Coarse authoring tier used when constructing the sample dataset. Not present in real annotator-labeled data.
